title: Optional Git Challenge
summary: Short optional pointer to an interactive Git tutorial for going deeper into topics not covered in the course, such as cherry-picking and rebasing.

concepts.heading: Optional extra practice
points: The course points to the free browser-based Learn Git Branching site (learngitbranching.js.org) for visual, level-by-level Git challenges.
It covers advanced topics beyond the course, including cherry-pick and rebase.
(Extra) Cherry-pick copies a single commit onto the current branch; rebase replays a branch's commits on top of another base to produce a linear history.
Entirely optional; not required for later sections.

task.name: Learn Git Branching challenges (optional)
task.starting_point: A web browser; no install needed.
task.goal: Work through the interactive levels to practise branching, merging, cherry-pick and rebase.
steps: Complete the introductory levels, then the advanced ones on rebase and cherry-pick.

gaps_and_ideas: Link to learngitbranching.js.org from the future Git lessons as an optional extension.
